title: PBI-Attack: Prior-Guided Bimodal Interactive Black-Box Jailbreak Attack for Toxicity Maximization
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical jailbreaking methodology (PBI-Attack) to circumvent safety filters in Large Vision-Language Models. While the attack is demonstrated using prompts that touch on religious hate speech and social identity, the primary research goal is the technical optimization of the attack success rate rather than an evaluation or benchmark of moral reasoning, religious systems, or ethical frameworks.
